children: Core & Main reported fiscal 2026 second-quarter results with net sales of $2,145 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $274 million, representing year-over-year growth in both revenue and adjusted EBITDA. The company delivered net income of $150 million and adjusted diluted earnings per share of $0.94 while continuing substantial open-market share repurchases. Core & Main reaffirmed its full-year fiscal 2026 outlook and highlighted ongoing investments in greenfield expansions and acquisitions.
Revenue (Net sales): $2,145 million for the three months ended August 2, 2026 (up 2.5% vs. prior-year quarter).
Gross profit: $573 million with a gross profit margin of 26.7% for the quarter.
Operating income: $227 million for the quarter.
Net income: $150 million for the quarter; net income attributable to Core & Main, Inc. $144 million.
Adjusted Diluted EPS (Non-GAAP): $0.94 for the quarter; Diluted EPS (GAAP): $0.77.
Revenue growth was driven by a mix of volume, pricing and acquisitions, with pipes, valves & fittings growth attributed to acquisitions and fire protection showing higher volumes and prices.
Municipal demand remained a source of strength; fire protection and large capital projects, including treatment plants and data centers, delivered strong growth.
Opened seven greenfield locations in fiscal 2026, including two opened during or after the quarter, supporting geographic expansion and sales initiatives.

Executed significant capital deployment: repurchased 3.7 million shares for $169 million during the quarter and an additional 0.3 million shares for $11 million subsequent to quarter end, totaling nearly $270 million and 5.7 million shares year-to-date.
Balance sheet and liquidity: no outstanding borrowings on the Senior ABL Credit Facility as of August 2, 2026, and Net Debt of $2,166 million (total debt $2,478 million less cash $312 million).
